test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

My heart _______ hard, bumping the broken glass, nicked by sharp edges.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Thumped'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this sentence, the** context suggests** that the heart is beating strongly or forcefully.
 
• The word **"thumped"** accurately conveys this meaning.
 
• **It implies** a strong, rhythmic pounding or beating, which aligns with the description of the heart in the given sentence. 

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *"My heart **thumped** hard, bumping the broken glass, nicked by sharp edges."*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• **Inhibited**- Held back or restrained, usually in the context of emotions or actions.(संयमित)
 
• **Lifted**: Raised to a higher position or level; also can mean improved in mood or spirit.(उठाया)
 
• **Thumped**: Hit heavily, especially with the hand or a blunt object.(ठोंका)
 
• **Thundered**: A loud, deep resounding noise, similar to the sound of thunder; can also imply speaking loudly or forcefully.(गरजा)
